{{Top|leg}}
The '''Threepethosk protocol droid''' was a type of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. It was a cheaply-made imitation of a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|type]] of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], which caused the company to file a lawsuit against the manufacturers of the Threepethosk droid.
